source: English canonical catalog plus owner-requested German marketing adaptations
scope: 220 shared messages: homepage/FAQ/demos/navigation/footer/subscription checkout, mobile welcome/settings/paywall subset
releaseAuthorization: User explicitly requested assessment, fixes, deployment and post-deployment Stripe verification.

evaluation.es: Meaning and terminology reviewed; fixed feature/billing distinction and marketing tone. Informal tú in Spain with Spain plural forms.
evaluation.es-419: Shared Spanish base reviewed with neutral Latin American plural forms, Configuración and ranking overrides; no country-specific idioms added.
evaluation.fr: International informal tu retained; programme for the feature and abonnement for billing. Fixed friends headline and gendered cancellation copy.
evaluation.zh-Hans: Simplified Chinese reviewed for natural UI wording, appearance uncertainty, distinct improvement/subscription terms, and retained community terminology. Traditional Chinese is outside scope.

findings.finding: Other locales retained older guesswork/friends/iPhone/Pro headings instead of the user-requested German marketing direction.
findings.resolution: Goal-focused feature, personal Protocol, competitive friends headline preserving mogging/Battle, download-now CTA and explicit subscription choice.

findings.finding: Plan referred to both the personal improvement feature and the purchased subscription.
findings.resolution: Protocolo for the feature; suscripción for recurring billing. Spain and Latin America retain their own ranking/settings terminology.

findings.finding: 计划 and 方案 were used inconsistently for feature and billing.
findings.resolution: 提升方案 / 专属提升方案 for the personal feature, 订阅方案 for billing. No literal translation as 协议.

findings.finding: The goal lost the English qualification about looking less bloated.
findings.resolution: 看起来更清瘦、浮肿感更少的脸部 describes appearance without implying guaranteed physiological change.

findings.finding: Spanish attributed cancellation to the user; French used an unnecessary masculine ready adjective.
findings.resolution: Neutral event wording and a readiness phrase without a gender assumption.

findings.finding: Marketing demos, header sign-in and footer labels remained English.
findings.resolution: Added 95 shared messages covering demos, task instructions, accessibility text and footer. Personal names remain user content; numerical scores are not changed.

findings.finding: Independent native-reader and regional comprehension testing has not been performed.
findings.resolution: Do not represent this AI review as human certification or assign a human-quality score.

findings.finding: Analysis/upload/results, legal page bodies and many mobile journeys are outside the implemented batch.
findings.resolution: This release exposes localized web homepage and plan selection; non-homepage locale pages remain noindex. Mobile catalogs are synchronized but no App Store binary is submitted.

remaining: EUR/CHF not shared across configured prices
